forest-canopy.$description: Forest Canopy — Primary page background, nav strip, footer canvas — the dominant surface that defines the entire brand atmosphere

vault-floor.$description: Vault Floor — Card surfaces, recessed panels, elevated content blocks within the forest canvas

canopy-mid.$description: Canopy Mid — Elevated card variant, highlighted surface tier above the base canvas

lime-phosphor.$description: Lime Phosphor — Primary action buttons, active state indicators, illustrative highlight panels, brand-accent moments — the sole chromatic signal in the system

moss-border.$description: Moss Border — Hairline dividers, list separators, subtle table borders — barely-there green-on-green rules

fern.$description: Fern — Secondary accent strokes, table emphasis borders, mid-saturation green used sparingly for variety within lime contexts

white.$description: White — Body text, heading text, icon strokes, ghost button borders, link colors, input fields — the only neutral light tone in the palette

denim-ink.$description: All interface text — from tiny labels to massive display headlines. The custom geometric face is the voice of the brand; weight 400 covers body and body-large, 600 for subheadings and emphasized inline, 700 reserved for the largest display moments. Extreme size jumps (40→64→86→94) create a poster-like hierarchy where the largest text dwarfs everything else on the page.

courier-new.$description: Tiny monospaced labels (8px) for micro-annotations, likely near icons or status indicators. Ultra-tight tracking (-0.14em) at this size reads as a decorative tech-glitch element rather than readable text.
